methods.name: boot
methods.description: Boots the SDK once: waits for the platform, signs in the guest session, loads configs and starts the eager modules. Resolves after `sdk:core:ready` is published.

returns.description: Resolves when the SDK is ready; rejects if initial authentication or a critical module fails. libraries.description: CM-72 deterministic random stream shared by all game mechanics. Portable seeds are case-sensitive ASCII. createSeed is for non-game utility randomness only; gameplay uses createRandom with a server-issued attempt seed. Published test vectors: @manygamescorp/core/random.vectors.json. snapshot() returns detached immutable JSON state (version 1, CM-72); restoreRandom validates it and resumes the next draw without reseeding.
